⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. HotCRM measured this on 18.3.0, and it holds on `main`. A `percent` screen field renders as text and posts a string, so both the client and the engine checks skip `min` / `max`. The run then consumes its suspension, and a downstream rule refuses it with only Close. The person loses the run with no retry. That makes it p2 rather than p3.
- Platform first, so `domain:server`: the engine's screen-input check must coerce or refuse a non-numeric value for a numeric field, never skip it. The `ScreenView.tsx` render and post is the `domain:ui` half, which the PR names.

Status: **needs_decision**. The dispatch's fork condition is reached before any code: both arms that close the gap change the published screen-field contract text in `packages/spec/src/**`, and the contract itself says a `type` member becomes a value domain only by ruling. No branch commits, no PR.

Readings on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` `bedb96e0`:

- Measured, `validateScreenInputs([{ name: 'discount', type, min: 0, max: 60 }], { discount: v })` (a throwaway vitest file in service-automation, deleted after the run):

  | `type` | `75` | `"75"` | `"60"` | `60` | `"abc"` |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | `percent` | `max_value` | `[]` | `[]` | `[]` | `[]` |
  | `currency` | `max_value` | `[]` | `[]` | `[]` | `[]` |
  | `number` | `max_value` | `invalid_type` | `invalid_type` | `[]` | `invalid_type` |

  So the card holds for `percent` and also for `currency` over REST: any string, `"abc"` included, passes and the run consumes the suspension. `number` refuses every string, `"60"` included.
- Why: `SCREEN_FIELD_VALUE_DOMAINS` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/screen-input-contract.ts:68-75`) holds `number` and `file` only, and the bound pass (line 253) skips any value that is not a JS number.
- The `number` refusal is maintainer ruling A′ (decision batch #130 item 1, 2026-09-13), and it says **refuse, never coerce**. The module docstring (lines 129-170) gives the reason: reading `"25"` as `25` "would make the bound's verdict depend on a coercion no part of this contract declares". It also says the set is closed and "a member joins it by ruling".
- The published contract says the same in `packages/spec/src/**`: `ScreenFieldSpec.type` / `.min` / `.max` jsdoc (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts:355-383`, "Two members are value domains", "⛔ Not coerced") and `ScreenFieldConfigSchema.type` / `.min` / `.max` (`packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts:957, 1029-1039`, "the shape refusal above reads `'number'` alone"). `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx:1305` names the same two shapes.
- The console half: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx:710` gives `htmlType: 'number'` to `number` and `currency` only, and line 726 posts `Number(...)` only for that numeric input. So the console posts `currency` as a number and `percent` as a string. Not touched (ui lane paused).

Why neither arm fits inside the order:

- **Coerce** (the order's suggested route: `"60"` accepted, `"75"` bound-checked): on `number` it reverses ruling A′; on `percent`/`currency` alone it makes two rules for numeric kinds (`number` refuses `"60"`, `percent` takes it). Either way the spec text above becomes false.
- **Refuse** (A′'s rule extended to `percent`/`currency`): consistent with A′, but the spec text still names two members, and with the console posting every `percent` value as a string, **every console submit of a `percent` field is refused**, `"50"` included, until the UI half lands. Today an in-range value works. That would turn "lose the dialog on an over-limit discount" into "the quote screen can never be submitted".

Ruling: needs_decision fork on #30178 (project review thread 「决定百分比和货币字段怎么校验字符串 #30178」) · letter **A** · maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-05T03:12Z

Completes ruling A′ (`5651909056`, decision batch #130 item 1, 2026-09-13) for the other two numeric screen-field kinds; reverses nothing.

## What the review thread re-verified (code read at `dfafae81` on `main`; the card thread measured at `bedb96e0`, report `6647359070`)

- `SCREEN_FIELD_VALUE_DOMAINS` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/screen-input-contract.ts`) holds `number` and `file` only, and the bound pass skips any value that is not a finite JS number. So a `percent` or `currency` screen field admits any string, `"abc"` included, and the run consumes its suspension; `number` refuses every string (A′).
- The console (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx`, the `htmlType` line) gives a numeric input to `number` and `currency` only, so `percent` renders as text and is posted as a string; the client bound check (`screenFieldBoundViolations`) compares a present number only. `ui/` is this repository's own source tree, compiled by `Type Check UI` against the PR's spec (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 4).
- Ruling A′'s own heading reads "a non-number for a **numeric field** is refused, never silently passed"; its item 2 spells `number`-typed. The sentence "the set is closed … a member joins it by ruling" is the implementer's docstring, not the maintainer's word.
- The spec already names the three numeric kinds as one group: `MEASURE_FIELD_TYPES = ['number', 'currency', 'percent']` (`packages/spec/src/data/aggregation-policy.ts`); the object field form shows `min`/`max` on that group plus `rating`/`slider`/`progress`.
- `ScreenFieldConfigSchema.type` stays `z.string().optional()` under every arm: the Zod SHAPE does not change, only the jsdoc / `.describe` prose and its generated mirrors. Neither `packages/spec/**` nor `ui/**` is on the Tier H register (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`); the landing owes a contract-review-tier record for the narrowing, not a human merge.
- In-tree example flows declare no `percent` / `currency` screen field; the known affected declaration is hotcrm's Generate Quote `discount`.

## Governing text

- Ruling A′ `5651909056` (heading and item 2) and its clarification `5652004815`: refuse, ⛔ never coerce; "skipping the dialog is refused too" with no qualifier.
- Triage `6641856071`: "the engine's screen-input check must coerce or refuse a non-numeric value for a numeric field, never skip it."
- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 12 (contract-first: ⛔ no lenient alias or fallback in a consumer to tolerate off-spec input) and Post-Task Checklist step 4 (a change that reds the Console under `ui/` ships together with the `ui/` fix in the same PR, or does not ship).
- ADR-0114 D2 (field-level error-code catalog: `invalid_type` already exists; no new code).

## The ruling: A

`percent` and `currency` join `number` in the screen-input value domain: a present value for a `type: 'percent'` or `type: 'currency'` screen field that is not a finite JSON number is refused on resume with the catalog's `invalid_type` inside `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT` (400, retryable, suspension kept), ⛔ never coerced — the same predicate and the same sentence `number` already has. The same PR maps `percent` to the console's numeric input (`htmlType: 'number'`, carrying `min`/`max`, posting a number), so the client bound check applies to it without a further change. The maintainer's 「同意」 covers that one `ui/` file on this `domain:server` card while the ui lane is paused.

Fixed here:

1. Engine: two rows in `SCREEN_FIELD_VALUE_DOMAINS` (`percent`, `currency`; predicate = finite JSON number; expected `a number`). The module docstring's "one member / two members" wording becomes the three numeric members plus `file`. ⛔ Not widened to `rating`, `slider`, `progress` or any other hint: the console has no numeric widget for them today; they stay widget hints until their own ruling.
2. Pins (service-automation): on `percent` and on `currency`, `"75"` → `invalid_type` (not `max_value`), `"abc"` → `invalid_type`, `"60"` → `invalid_type`, `75` → `max_value`, `60` → `[]`; `text`, untyped and `rating` fields still admit a string; a hidden field is not judged; the ablation (remove the two rows) reds the negative pins.
3. Console: `ScreenView.tsx` — `percent` takes the numeric input path (one line) with one pin: a `percent` field renders `type="number"` carrying `min`/`max` and submits a number. A dedicated percent widget (suffix, formatting) is the ui lane's later choice and is not decided here.
4. Spec prose: `ScreenFieldSpec.type` / `.min` / `.max` jsdoc (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`), `ScreenFieldConfigSchema.type` / `.min` / `.max` jsdoc and `.describe` (`packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts`), the sentence in `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`, and the regenerated spec artifacts (AGENTS.md § *Touched `packages/spec`*). No Zod shape change, no new key, no tombstone, no ADR-0087 migration entry.
5. Landing: one PR on the card thread's branch, `Fixes #30178` (both halves land), `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition marker in both changesets (`@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-automation`; level per the launch-window guard — A′'s landing took `minor` on both), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Ruling-ref: <this comment id>`; a contract-review-tier record on the final head before the queue.
6. ⛔ Not: coercing a numeric string for the bound pass (B — reverses A′ and leaves a string in the flow variable); leaving the engine untouched (C); shipping the `percent` refusal without the console line (every console `percent` submit would be refused).

### Why A, on the four axes (business standpoint)

- **① Long-term soundness (≥50%).** One rule for the numeric kinds, the same rule the object protocol already states by grouping `number`/`currency`/`percent`. A′'s heading already said "numeric field"; A completes it. Coercion in the engine would be the consumer-side leniency Prime Directive 12 forbids and would hide the console defect that caused the loss.
- **② Measured business pull.** HotCRM measured on 18.3.0; triage raised it to p2 because an over-limit discount loses the run. Every console user of a bounded `percent` screen field; API and MCP callers posting strings to `currency` fields today pass unjudged.
- **③ AI-error prevention.** The failure direction stays loud (400, retryable, suspension kept). The one trap — engine first, console later — is closed by shipping both halves in one PR under `Type Check UI` and the console pin gates.
- **④ Startup no-sprawl.** Two table rows, three prose sites, one console line, two pins; no new code path, error code or seam; S.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
① 长远:数值类屏幕字段只有一条规则,与对象字段同组(`MEASURE_FIELD_TYPES`);A′ 标题本就写「numeric field」,A 是补全不是推翻;引擎强转是首要指令 12 禁止的消费端宽容,且盖住控制台的根因。
② 拉动:HotCRM 在 18.3.0 实测、分诊升 p2(折扣超限丢运行);每个声明带上下限 percent 屏幕字段的客户;API/MCP 调用方往 currency 发字符串今天无人判。
③ 防错:失败方向响亮(400 可重试、挂起保留);「引擎先发、控制台后发」的坑由同 PR 两半 + Type Check UI 封住。
④ 不扩散:值域表两行、prose 三处、ui 一行、两钉;不加路径、不加错误码、不加接缝;S。
Prior rulings read: "screen field number refuse coerce string gap", "numeric field bound resume" → A′ `5651909056` + `5652004815` (#17306); #25801 (`file` joined the set); triage `6641856071`; dispatch `6647305770`; report `6647359070`; seat note `6647378538`.

- `domain:server` seat 4 holds the claim (`6647305770`) and dispatches from it: the card body's first line becomes `Ruled: <this comment id> · letter A · <UTC>`; the dispatch order's file surface widens to the engine module and its tests, the two spec files and their regenerated artifacts, `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx` and its test, and two changesets. Still ⛔ `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, every other `ui/**` path. ⛔ Ruling is not dispatching.
- The card thread resumes on `claude/project-thread-xq1cua` with the pins and the ablation above; `Refs` becomes `Fixes #30178`.
- hotcrm re-measures hotcrm#2396 on the fixing pin, as the card body says; nothing in that repository is touched from here.
- Not reopened: the `number` and `file` rules; `rating` / `slider` / `progress` as widget hints; a dedicated percent widget; the ui lane's pause for anything but this one file.
